# Folio

Source-grounded analysis and evidence-linked, single-file reports for Claude Code
and Codex. No server, MCP or other plugin installation is required; deterministic
scripts use Python 3's standard library.

Use `folio:report` to route the complete workflow, or independently invoke
`prepare`, `analyze`, `verify`, `connect`, `render`. Original-source verification
does not include external fact search. Rendering can stop at a content-neutral
formal shell or export HTML/Markdown; report headings remain free-form.

HTML contains report/material views and quotation/aggregate evidence navigation,
with all required UI resources embedded. Markdown citations leave identifiable
document/position/quote trails even when original files are unavailable to the
recipient. Shared links do not guarantee recipient permissions.

Read `references/contract.md` for the portable bundle and command examples.
Keep generated work outside the plugin directory. Source snapshots, findings
and semantic review are explicit; structural script checks do not prove meaning.

This package contains no real interview materials. Final visual sufficiency and
external publication remain the user's decisions.
